prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 educational atlas. Only TOP LEFT, TOP RIGHT and BOTTOM LEFT contain the three unrelated subjects below; BOTTOM RIGHT remains EMPTY WHITE. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: use restrained blue-charcoal ink with pale watercolor and small natural color accents on opaque PURE WHITE. Do not reproduce its subjects. No writing, captions, borders, grid, watermark. EXACT 2x2 row-major placement. Entire subjects must be SMALLER, compact and fit the central 60% of EACH quadrant with at least 15% empty white margin on all four sides. A wide horizontal white band occupies 44–58% canvas height; a wide vertical white band occupies 44–56% canvas width. No mast, roof, head, card or pencil may cross the midlines. All people have natural anatomy, exactly two arms and two legs per person.
TOP LEFT — naval (海军的): Three naval sailors in plain white uniforms stand together beside a small low ship cabin and a moored grey naval vessel WITHOUT tall masts in the background. Complete sailors and complete low vessel fully contained within central 60% of quadrant, large clear white margin above all hats and below shoes. Navy-related scene, no battle.
TOP RIGHT — symbol (符号): Two separate plain rectangular cards stand upright side by side: one card has a simple large blue heart icon, the other has a simple navy outline dove silhouette. These are meaningful visual symbols. Cards only, NO person or hands, no text. Compact centered composition, generous white space.
BOTTOM LEFT — illusion (错觉): An optical illusion with a straight yellow pencil partly immersed in a transparent glass half full of pale blue water. CRITICAL: its visible image MUST have a LARGE, unmistakable apparent kink exactly at the water surface. The dry pencil above the water slopes down-left; the refracted submerged pencil image begins offset sideways at the waterline and follows a distinctly steeper angle, visibly appearing bent. No straight continuous diagonal, no real snapped pencil, no labels or person. Complete glass and pencil centered with generous white margins.
BOTTOM RIGHT — EMPTY WHITE.
review_notes: Symbol is two cards with no hands, and illusion now has a clear apparent kink at waterline; both are fully contained. Naval is excluded for another right-edge intrusion.
